prompts.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. New high-resolution key visual for Divar portfolio. The supplied collage is a STYLE AND CHARACTER REFERENCE ONLY: recreate the design language, do NOT reuse, crop or reproduce the collage itself. Premium stylised CGI, confident minimalist composition, vivid Divar red seamless background with subtle dimensional studio light, warm yellow accents, porcelain-white objects and charcoal details, crisp physically believable materials. Main AI mascot must match reference top-left: floating rounded-square ivory robot body, inset dark square display with amber glow, TWO articulated white/black robotic arms with well formed hands, small dark cylindrical thruster underneath. No separate legs, no bulbous humanoid robot. No logos, NO readable text, no watermarks, no sketches. Opaque full background, never transparent. Entire subject inside generous safe margin. SQUARE 2048x2048 cover. Hero mascot in three-quarter view hovering centrally, screen shows a simple amber smiling pair of eyes. One hand guiding one floating ivory classified listing card with yellow photo placeholder and three grey lines. Another small card behind, subtle jet glow underneath. Deliberately few objects, large clear red negative space around silhouette. Focus on mascot identity, polished and welcoming.
